topics.title_zh: Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge声称利用Claude破解黎曼猜想
topics.title_en: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge Claims Claude Solved the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic数学家莱文特·阿尔波格 (Levent Alpöge) 公开宣布在Claude辅助下证明了数学史上最著名的黎曼猜想，并以Lean编程语言发布了证明过程。此举若获证实，将标志着AI从工具演进为解决顶级科学难题的核心智力引擎。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced he used Claude to prove the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis, publishing the result in the Lean language. If verified, this marks a pivot from AI as a productivity tool to a core engine for solving historic scientific enigmas.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进派 / AI科研赋能支持者
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI能够处理人类数学家难以跨越的计算复杂度与形式化验证，黎曼猜想的证明若属实，将是AI辅助发现的里程碑。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI overcomes the computational complexity that limits human mathematicians; this proof would be a milestone in machine-aided scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 数学严谨性怀疑者
perspective_con.point_zh: 目前证明仍处于早期验证阶段，AI模型产生的逻辑链可能存在‘幻觉式逻辑陷阱’，必须通过顶级数学同行评审的严格校验。
perspective_con.point_en: The proof is in the early verification stage; AI models often generate 'hallucinatory logic traps' that require rigorous peer review by the math community.

linked_tweets.author: Chubby♨️
linked_tweets.content_zh:
今天创造了历史。人类将在回顾 2026 年时思考：这是我们跨过的门槛，从那一刻起，每个人的未来都将永远改变。

人们可能在 2025 年底通过 Claude Code 第一次感觉到事情正在发生变化，当时代理人工智能对他们来说变得真正有形。 2026 年上半年，事情加速发展。模型发布越来越频繁，大家都能感受到模型之间的差距和改进越来越明显。然而到了2026年下半年，却出现了质的飞跃。这不再只是模型变得更好了。人工智能产生的见解、结果、产出和科学解决方案变得更加令人印象深刻，今天它们可能已经达到了绝对的顶峰。

OpenAI 率先解决了纳维-斯托克斯问题，这是人类在很长一段时间内未能解决的千年奖问题。几周后，他们发表了 300 多个开放数学问题的结果，其中许多问题几十年来都没有得到解决。整个科学界都惊呆了，震惊不已。但今天 Anthropic 更进一步。 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 合作，几乎肯定证明了黎曼猜想。这实在是难以用言语来形容，令人难以置信，深不可测。我想说，今天是超级智能的证明。 167 年来一直没有解决的最伟大的数学问题之一，数学和科学的圣杯，即使不是最伟大的，也已经陨落了。接下来，每个人都应该清楚，所有其他问题也会随之下降。

我们知道，人工智能模型的发展不断向前发展，而这只是迈向更好模型的第一步。如果黎曼假设今天已经得到证明，那么根本不知道更好的模型会解决什么问题。达里奥·阿莫迪表示，人工智能很可能会治愈疾病，甚至可能治愈所有疾病。尽管这是两个不同的科学学科，但这些突破的意义表明，这种情况变得越来越有可能。 2026 年将作为一个转折点载入人类历史，奇点变得有形的那一刻。 2027 年将是奇点以全力和全面影响力进入现实的一年。

我感到震惊和兴奋，不知道该怎么想。但内心深处却感到喜悦。

这一天对我们所有人来说都是最美好的日子之一。
linked_tweets.content_en:
History was made today. Humanity will look back on 2026 and think: this was the threshold we crossed, the moment the future changed for everyone, forever.

People probably first sensed that something was shifting in late 2025 with Claude Code, when agentic AI became truly tangible for them. In the first half of 2026, things picked up speed. Model releases became more frequent, and everyone could feel the gaps between models and the improvements becoming more and more tangible. In the second half of 2026, however, there was a qualitative leap. It was no longer just the models getting better. It was the insights, the results, the outputs, the scientific solutions produced with AI that became more impressive, and today they have probably reached their absolute peak.

OpenAI led the way and solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a Millennium Prize Problem that humans had failed to solve for a very, very long time. A few weeks later, they published results on more than 300 open mathematical problems, many of which had also gone unsolved for decades. The entire scientific world was stunned, frozen in shock. But today Anthropic went a step further. Levent Alpöge, working with Claude, has almost certainly proven the Riemann Hypothesis. This is, and it’s hard to put into words, incredible and unfathomable. Today, I would say, is the proof of superintelligence. One of the greatest mathematical problems, if not the greatest, unsolved for 167 years, the holy grail of mathematics and science, has fallen. And it follows, and this should be clear to everyone, that all other problems will fall too.

We know that the development of AI models keeps moving forward relentlessly, and that this is just one step on the path to ever better models. And if the Riemann Hypothesis has already been proven today, there is simply no telling what even better models will solve. Dario Amodei said that AI will in all likelihood cure diseases, perhaps even all diseases. And although these are two different scientific disciplines, the significance of these breakthroughs shows that this is becoming more and more likely. 2026 will go down in human history as a turning point, the moment the singularity became tangible. And 2027 will be the year the singularity breaks into reality with full force and full impact.

I am in shock and excitement and I don't know what to think. But deep inside if feel joy. 

This day is one of the best days ever for all of us.

topics.title_en: Signal Blocks Screenshots to Prevent System-level AI Agents from Scraping Privacy
topics.summary_zh: Signal总裁Meredith Whittaker宣布在iOS与Android端默认禁用截屏功能，旨在阻断苹果、谷歌Gemini等系统级AI代理对端到端加密聊天的静默数据抓取，引发全球关于AI时代隐私主权与系统权限的激烈博弈。
topics.summary_en: Signal CEO Meredith Whittaker announced a default block on screen captures to prevent system-level AI agents like Gemini from scraping end-to-end encrypted chats, sparking a global debate over AI-era privacy sovereignty.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 隐私卫士 / 数字权利主张者
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI代理正在将用户设备变成透明的监控窗口，必须通过硬件级强制手段将隐私控制权从厂商AI手中夺回。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI agents turn user devices into transparent surveillance windows; we must reclaim privacy control through hard-coded technical restrictions.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业效能派 / 用户体验支持者
perspective_con.point_zh: 限制功能虽然保护了隐私，但也阻碍了操作系统提供无缝AI智能化服务的初衷，是一种极端的排他主义。
perspective_con.point_en: While protecting privacy, this restriction sabotages the goal of seamless OS intelligence, representing an extreme form of exclusionary policy.

topics.title_zh: Anthropic上市后股价剧震，超千亿募资额遭市场质疑
topics.title_en: Anthropic Shares Slump as $119B Total Raise Faces Investor Skepticism
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic在完成包括IPO及后续超额配售在内、总额达1195亿美元的融资后，股价随即大幅震荡，首日涨幅几乎被抹平。资本市场正重新评估其高估值背后的烧钱模式与模型推理商业价值。
topics.summary_en: Following a massive $119.5B fundraising haul through IPO and subsequent allotments, Anthropic's stock saw significant volatility, erasing most of its first-day gains as investors re-examine the sustainability of its burn rate.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 长期扩张派 / 资本驱动者
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Wall Street AI Focused Fund Managers
perspective_pro.point_zh: 规模效应需要海量资本支撑。Anthropic在模型能力上的领先溢价足以支撑其高估值，短期股价波动属于市场情绪调整。
perspective_pro.point_en: Scale requires massive capital; Anthropic's leadership in model performance justifies the premium, making short-term fluctuations mere market noise.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 价值投资者
perspective_con.point_zh: 千亿美元募资额脱离了基本的商业盈利逻辑。AI模型研发的边际成本不断攀升，如果无法快速落地企业级应用，风险极高。
perspective_con.point_en: A $100B+ valuation defies fundamental business logic. Marginal costs for model training keep rising, posing extreme risks without clear, rapid enterprise-scale ROI.
